files.template:
-- Hyprland's own configuration, and one line VMLord adds to it.
--
-- Hyprland copies its default into a user's own directory only when it
-- finds no configuration anywhere, and it looks here first, so this file
-- is read instead of that copy being made. It loads the same default the
-- distribution ships, so nothing about the desktop is decided here.
--
-- The line is waybar: the panel is what carries the tray, and the default
-- leaves every autostart commented out, so a guest given the package alone
-- gets a compositor with no panel and no tray on it.
dofile("/usr/share/hypr/hyprland.lua")

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    hl.exec_cmd("waybar")
end)
